W.P. No. 15748 of 2025

calling for records pertaining to gazette notification dated 21-9-2022 bearing no G.O (M.S) 196 of 2022 as it is issued against the procedure laid down as per the tamil nadu acquisition of land for industrial purposes act, 1997 along with corresponding rules, 2001 and quash the same calling for records pertaining to gazette notification dated 17-7-2023 bearing no G.O (M. S)141 of 2023 as it is issued against the procedure laid down as per the tamil nadu acquisition of land for industrial purposes act, 1997 along with corresponding rules, 2001 and quash the same calling for records pertaining to gazette notification dated 31-12-2024 bearing no G.O M. S dated 428 of 2024 as it is issued against the procedure laid down in Section 3(1) of the tamil nadu acquisition of land for industrial purposes act, 1997 along with corresponding rules, 2001 and quash the same.

WP No. 9034 of 2025

CALLING FOR RECORDS PERTAINING to the order dated 14-2-2025 bearing No. Roc No. 20/2023/spl Tah/sipcot issued by the 5th respondent as it rendered without complying due procedure established under the tamilnadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial purposes Act, 1997 along with corresponding Rules, 2001 read with Section 26-30 read with schedule I right to Fair compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition Act, 2013 and quash the same.

WP No. 9052 of 2025

CALLING FOR RECORDS PERTAINING to the order dated 14-2-2025 bearing No. Roc No. 20/2023/spl Tah/sipcot issued by the 5th respondent as it rendered without complying due procedure established under the tamilnadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial purposes Act, 1997 along with corresponding Rules, 2001 read with Section 26-30 read with schedule I right to Fair compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition Act, 2013 and quash the same.

WP No. 15754 of 2025

calling for records pertaining to the public notice dated 24-11-2016 bearing document No. 29891/2016/B2 issued by the 3rd respondent as it is issued against the procedure laid down in Section 3(2) of the tamil nadu acquisition of land for industrial purposes act, 1997 along with corresponding rules, 2001 and quash the same.

WP No. 16245 of 2025

calling for records pertaining to the Public Notice dated 7-10-2016 bearing document No. 21004/2016/B2 issued by the 3rd Respondent as it is issued against the procedure laid down as per Section 3(2) of the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997, along with corresponding Rules, 2001 and Quash the same and calling for records pertaining to the Public Notice dated 15-10-2016 bearing document No. 21003/2016/B2 issued by the 3rd Respondent as it is issued against the procedure laid down in Section 3(2) of the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997, along with corresponding Rules, 2001 and Quash the same.

WP No. 16263 of 2025

calling for records pertaining to Gazette notification dated 29-3-2022 bearing No G.O M.S. 189 of 2022 as it is issued against the procedure laid down in Section 3(1) of the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 along with corresponding Rules, 2001 and Quash the same and calling for records pertaining to Gazette notification dated 11-9-2023 bearing No G.O M.S. 336 of 2023 as it is issued against the procedure laid down in Section 3(1) of the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 along with corresponding Rules, 2001 and Quash the same and calling for records pertaining to Gazette notification dated 20-9-2024 bearing No G.O M.S 128 of 2024 as it is issued against the procedure laid down in Section 3(2) of the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 along with corresponding Rules, 2001 and Quash the same.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Abdul Quddhose, J.:— These writ petitions are listed under the caption “for withdrawal”.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission of this Court to withdraw these writ petitions. However, he seeks liberty for the petitioners to revive these writ petitions in case the respondents fail to comply with their board of resolution dated 9-12-2025.

3. As per the aforesaid board of resolution dated 9-12-2025, the respondents have agreed to release 33.11 acres of land out of the total extent of 66.52 acres of land, which was earlier the subject matter of the land acquisition. The Board of resolution dated 9-12-2025 passed by the respondents (SIPCOT) is placed on record by the learned counsel for the petitioners.

4. As seen from the same, the respondents (SIPCOT) have agreed to grant exemption in respect of 33.11 acres of land from acquisition of the total extent of 66.52 acres of land, which was earlier acquired by the respondents (SIPCOT) As a condition, the respondents (SIPCOT) in their resolution dated 9-12-2025 had made it clear that all the writ petitions will have to be withdrawn unconditionally by the petitioners.

5. In terms of the resolution dated 9-12-2025 passed by the respondents (SIPCOT), the petitioners have decided to withdraw these writ petitions.

Accordingly, these writ petitions are dismissed as withdrawn. Liberty is granted to revive the prayer sought for in these writ petitions in case the resolution dated 9-12-2025 passed by the respondents (SIPCOT) is not adhered to by them.

Consequently, connected WMPs are closed. No costs.
